name: Handwriting Engine
description: The engine of handwriting recognition on this computer (ONNX Runtime). It is installed from the settings page of Handwriting and loaded only while handwriting is recognized. It holds no models: they are downloaded on that page. Nothing is sent anywhere.
author: Quillbinder
details: ONNX Runtime by Microsoft, the official build for Linux x64, unchanged; the computations run on the processor.
Quillbinder opens it at run time; the program itself does not link it.
